# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that fails to hold above the 8EMA while showing weakening RSI (below 50) presents a fade short opportunity. This edge exists because gap ups often attract late buyers who become trapped when the gap fails to hold, creating short-term mean reversion pressure, especially when confirmed by ribbon weakness (EMA8 failure) and deteriorating momentum (RSI<50) in elevated volatility regimes (VIX>20).

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Today's open > prior day's close (gap up) AND open > VWAP, but the first 5-minute bar after open fails to close above EMA8, AND RSI(14) < 50; enter short at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed above the high of the gap bar (chart stop). Initial target = 1× ATR from entry. After price moves 0.5R in favor, activate a chandelier exit trail (ATR×2.5) to manage the runner.  
**Regime filter:** Only consider entries in the first 30 minutes after open when VIX > 20 (elevated volatility).  
**Note:** This is a PUT-only short bias candidate aligned with OP-16 bearish anchor days.
